Name: IdaIda's Furniture Recolor (for AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
Alternative Textures pack for IdaIda's Furniture Recolor. Big thank you to [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48653578][color=#a2c4c9]PastelLily[/color][/url][color=#b4a7d6], who coded the AT version.[/color]



[color=#b4a7d6]The colors of this mod should work well with vanilla and world recolors. [/color]
[color=#b4a7d6]The furniture is less saturated and the colors are more cohesive. There are full sets of light and dark wood, birch, white, and grey.[/color]
[color=#b4a7d6]The decorative elements are moons and suns, a lot of plants, including more trendy houseplants, there's also a lot of crystal themed items.[/color]
[color=#b4a7d6]There are some recolors that allow you to make a bathroom- you can take a 'bath' in a retextured bed, sit on a chair toilet and add a sink and shower :)[/color]

[color=#b4a7d6]All the sprites in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.[/color]
[color=#b4a7d6]Conversion to AT was done by [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48653578][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48653578][color=#a2c4c9]PastelLily[/color][/url]
